summary_en: ROE 5.5% (FY3/26 actual) targeting 5.9% (FY3/27). Operating margin 2.8% (FY3/26) to 3.1% (FY3/27). New three-year plan (FY3/26–28): boneless fish focus, B2B and B2C expansion, Vietnam/Thailand/China exports, supply-chain diversification, working-capital optimization.
title_en: Response to realize management conscious of capital cost and share price
translation_en_brief: Dairei Co. announced on 16 June 2026 a strategic response to manage capital cost and share price. Current ROE stands at 5.5% (FY3/26), with PBR at 1.32x. The company notes persistent operating profit decline (693M yen FY3/26, down from 1.5B yen FY3/23) and identifies shortfall against shareholder long-term growth expectations as key drivers of PBR volatility. The board adopted a new three-year mid-term plan (FY3/26–28) targeting ROE of 5.9% and operating margin of 3.1% in FY3/27. Execution levers include: (1) major customer account expansion in foodservice and contract catering; (2) B2B and B2C market penetration beyond foodservice into retail and e-commerce; (3) geographic diversification of exports (Vietnam, Thailand, China); (4) supply-chain risk mitigation via multi-sourcing of fish and meat; and (5) balanced capital allocation across shareholder dividends, workforce investment, and growth capex. The company repositions itself as a fabless food manufacturer, emphasizing collaborative efficiency with partner producers and food-waste reduction.
